items.title: How He Became a Software Developer Using Only a Phone
items.summary: In episode 1009 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Steve Mock, Investor at Blumberg Capital about an extraordinary story from aisavedme.org: a young man in The Gambia, without a computer, used only a smartphone and AI to become a software developer and start a youth movement. This powerful example demonstrates how 'technology does not replace determination, it amplifies it,' showcasing AI's potential for global empowerment.

items.title: Ternary Bonsai 27B Local Test | 27B Model Running on a Phone? | Reasoning, Coding, Game Dev
items.summary:
Bonsai 27B is a multimodal model by PrismML, based on Qwen 3.6 27B, extremely quantized in ternary or binary format. The authors claim that the ternary variant preserves ~95% of the intelligence of the full-precision Qwen model. We'll take the Ternary Bonsai 27B for a local test with llama.cpp and compare it to the Q4 version of Qwen 3.6 27B and verify the claims.

Weights: https://huggingface.co/prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-27B-gguf

items.title: 6-dim Harness w/ MEMORY via Textual Gradients
items.summary:
What happens when an AI agent stops using one fixed control system for every problem? 

This new research shows how a frozen LLM can reuse execution experience to reconfigure its own context, tools, memory, orchestration, and output strategy for each new task: without retraining its weights. 

The result is a shift from static agents toward adaptive computational systems that learn not only what to answer, but how to organize themselves (!) before answering.
